product_tools.name: ngertiin.machine_exec
product_tools.description: Run shell work in the authorized human/organization execution domain. The returned process can keep running; use machine_process to read output or control it. A host-native terminal is not this machine.

inputSchema.description: Run shell work in the authorized human/organization execution domain. The returned process can keep running; use machine_process to read output or control it. A host-native terminal is not this machine.

product_tools.name: ngertiin.machine_window
product_tools.description: Open a task-owned browser window (same persistent login profile) or GUI terminal. Temporary windows and their tabs close automatically only after the entire task/handoff chain succeeds and its processes exit. Use keep_open for a preview/result the user should inspect, or retain an existing resource_id before finishing. List returns this task's managed windows. Existing user windows, files and login data are preserved. Human takeover preserves managed windows because human edits cannot be attributed safely.

Existing user windows, files and login data are preserved. Human takeover preserves managed windows because human edits cannot be attributed safely.

product_tools.name: ngertiin.machine_control
product_tools.description: Acquire or release input across a multi-step desktop interaction. Human takeover owns the same input. Reconcile an unknown input lease only after observing current state; this never repeats the uncertain action.

inputSchema.description: Acquire or release input across a multi-step desktop interaction. Human takeover owns the same input. Reconcile an unknown input lease only after observing current state; this never repeats the uncertain action.

product_tools.name: ngertiin.computer_call
product_tools.description: Call an available native Cua tool using its exact schema from computer_tools. Distinct actions need fresh command_id. Session identity is server-owned; foreground input requires the shared input lease. Inspect structuredJson for refusal or unverifiable effects and observe before retrying.

Decide from the full conversation and intended follow-through. Ordinary requests, complex work, file output and peer delegation alone do not require a Goal. Reuse the existing identity for corrections.

product_tools.name: ngertiin.group_read_task

After your handoff, finish the current turn instead of polling: group execution is serialized, so the peer cannot start until your turn ends. The application resumes the owner with the settled result.

product_tools.name: ngertiin.group_handoff
product_tools.description: Delegate work or request a peer review in the current group. Supply a concise public announcement in your own words; the application publishes it before the peer starts. Put technical execution instructions separately in instruction. The task already retains its result and continuation owner; delegation alone does not require a Goal. Contribute to an existing Goal when applicable. Handoff yields execution: the peer is queued and cannot start while your current group turn is active. Finish this turn after the receipt; do not wait, sleep or poll task status. The application follows the selected continuation mode after the peer settles.

announcement.description: Your concise public message explaining this handoff or sharing the useful result before asking the peer. Write naturally in your own words; keep private execution instructions in instruction.

chronology.anchor: First observed same-run agent conversation message; input-message fallback when no agent output exists.
chronology.offset: UTF-16 code units (JavaScript String.length); null for input-message or legacy fallback.
chronology.prefix_hash: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 observed message prefix; never replace the first anchor on later observations.
chronology.unavailable: Use a per-run fallback when message/prefix is unavailable or changed; do not fabricate engine ordering or timestamps.

native_interactions.response_replay: Same submitted answer returns its acknowledgement without native dispatch; changed input conflicts.
native_interactions.unknown_response: An in-flight attempt after timeout, disconnect or restart is fenced until an acknowledgement for that same attempt is observed. Never blindly replay.
native_interactions.observation: Request disappearance, native submission acknowledgement and run termination are separate observations; none establishes that an approved action completed.
native_interactions.privacy: Organization/user-private normalized requests and redacted answer displays only; no opaque native event or response-body log.

event.snapshot_cursor: Resume after the atomic conversation snapshot cursor; history pages are separate reads.

errors.retry: Read code, outcome and durable receipt before deciding whether another dispatch is safe.

state.cancellation: requested is intent; confirmed requires a matching terminal observation or local undispatched cancellation.
state.outcome: HTTP success and agent text do not establish a native or external effect outcome.
state.usage: Unavailable native usage remains unknown; no zero or unlimited inference is made.
state.billing: Authentication method and effective billing are distinct; no silent fallback.
state.conversational_cancellation: The native agent interprets chat/steering and calls scoped cancel_run or goal/Routine tools; new chat admission never classifies cancellation text.
state.direct_cancellation: POST /v1/runs/:id/cancel remains independent of model processing and ordinary queue delivery.
